outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram/table illustrating breast cancer classification and frequencies, not a statistical plot comparing groups.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic outlining the study aims, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic illustration of the experimental setup (luciferase recording), not a statistical plot.
Panel D shows illustrative example traces representing an analysis workflow, not real quantitative data requiring statistical comparison.
Panel E is a schematic heatmap illustrating the concept of correlation analysis, not an actual statistical result requiring a named test.
Panel F shows an illustrative example growth curve graphic depicting the workflow concept, not actual data with statistical comparisons.
Panel G shows an illustrative example dose-response curve graphic depicting the workflow concept, not actual data with statistical comparisons.
Panel H is a schematic depicting the genomic analysis workflow (heatmap/mutation matrix icons), not actual results requiring a statistical test.

Panel I shows illustrative schematic scatter plots (PCA and 3D clustering) representing the concept of subtype definition, with no significance claims or comparisons requiring a stated statistical test.
